[[File:ChunkerBunkerInterior.jpg|thumb|right|A group of Chunkers strolling through their base.]]
The '''Chunker Bunker''' was a bunker located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was used as a base of operations for the [[Chunkers]],<ref name="SWG" /> a gang of [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]<ref name="CDAG">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80112|text=CorSec Database A-G|int=CorSec Database A-G}}</ref> which operated out of the [[Double Worlds|Twin World]] of Talus. The bunker was located just southwest of [[Lake Thorn|Lake Bondoma]].<ref name="SWG" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer visited the bunker, fought some Chunkers and collected a [[Darksting assassin]] riffle.<ref name="SWG:RRWMI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Rifle Weapons Mark I}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Chunker Bunker was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Chunker Bunker was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]," released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>
